# Functions that read the status of an answer from the platform and report no
# failure through the renderer, because they cannot fail the command.
#
# cmd/drift/httperrors_test.go reads every non-test Go file under cmd/ and holds
# each function that calls one of common's Do* request functions and reads a
# response's StatusCode to this: it names common.CheckResponse, common.NewAPIError
# or common.APIError, and it never throws away the error common.CheckResponse
# returns. A function outside that is a failure written by hand, which has no
# code line, no note that a 5xx is the platform's and none of a quota's numbers.
#
# A function listed here is held to neither. One per line: its package directory,
# a dot and its name (a method is Type.method, and a variable that holds a function
# is its own name), then two spaces, a # and the reason it builds no failure. The
# usual reason is that the read is a best-effort probe whose failure reads as an
# answer the caller already has a way to act on.
#
# The list can only shrink. A line with no reason, a line that names no function
# and a line whose function the scan no longer flags each fail the test, and the
# line is deleted.
